body_usable_claim: Educational LLM agents have been surveyed across pedagogical tasks, enabling technologies, and deployment challenges.
evidence_location: Findings of EMNLP 2025, abstract; PDF Sections 2-4 and pp.13782-13810
forbidden_extension: Does not prove that multi-agent systems outperform fair monolithic baselines.

body_usable_claim: Multi-agent communication is among the capabilities discussed for educational LLM agents.
evidence_location: PDF introduction and technical framework discussion; p.13782 onward
forbidden_extension: Do not claim this paper introduced the first educational multi-agent system.

body_usable_claim: MultiTutor coordinates specialized agents to produce explanations, visualizations, resources, practice problems, and interactive simulations.
evidence_location: PMLR 273 authority abstract; PDF pp.174-190, framework description
forbidden_extension: Do not generalize its reported results to all multi-agent education systems.

body_usable_claim: MultiTutor reports automatic-metric and case-study comparisons with baseline models.
evidence_location: PMLR 273 authority abstract; PDF pp.174-190, evaluation and case-study sections
forbidden_extension: Do not call it a budget-matched causal demonstration of role decomposition.

body_usable_claim: Cross-cultural pragmatic failure includes pragmalinguistic and sociopragmatic dimensions.
evidence_location: Applied Linguistics 4(2), pp.91-112; abstract and conceptual discussion
forbidden_extension: Do not attribute LLM-specific findings to this 1983 paper.

body_usable_claim: Cross-cultural pragmatics instruction should avoid prescriptivism and support metapragmatic awareness.
evidence_location: Applied Linguistics 4(2), abstract/conclusion, pp.91-112
forbidden_extension: Do not turn cultural tendencies into universal rules.

body_usable_claim: Generative AI lacks human lived social experience and can produce pragmatically inappropriate language.
evidence_location: arXiv:2410.14395, abstract and pp.2-4
forbidden_extension: Does not prove that the proposed A3 agent fixes these limitations.

body_usable_claim: English-dominant and Western training data create linguistic and cultural authenticity concerns for L2 use.
evidence_location: arXiv:2410.14395, abstract and p.2
forbidden_extension: Do not claim every model or output is Western-biased.

body_usable_claim: ChatGPT has been examined as a conversational agent for Spanish-speaking learners of Chinese.
evidence_location: Sinología Hispánica 18(1), pp.71-98, title/abstract/method discussion
forbidden_extension: Do not infer robust causal learning gains or generalize to all L1 groups.

body_usable_claim: The study reports potential benefits for communicative motivation, learning-content accuracy, and intercultural barriers.
evidence_location: Sinología Hispánica 18(1), abstract and conclusion
forbidden_extension: Write 'reports/suggests', not 'proves' or 'significantly improves'.

body_usable_claim: Intralingual cultural adaptation has been defined as an LLM task with an evaluation framework.
evidence_location: CoNLL 2024, abstract and task definition, pp.400-418
forbidden_extension: Do not claim native-culture-aware generation is absent from prior NLP.

body_usable_claim: Automatic cultural adaptation can introduce issues requiring explicit evaluation.
evidence_location: CoNLL 2024, abstract and analysis sections, pp.400-418
forbidden_extension: Does not validate the present system's cultural accuracy.

body_usable_claim: Culturally-aware conversational evaluation has been grounded in situational, relational, and cultural context and annotated by culturally diverse raters.
evidence_location: HCI+NLP 2025, abstract and framework/data sections, pp.220-229
forbidden_extension: Do not call the present evaluation the first cross-cultural LLM benchmark.

body_usable_claim: Evaluated LLMs struggled with cultural adaptation in the paper's multicultural conversational benchmark.
evidence_location: HCI+NLP 2025, abstract and results, pp.220-229
forbidden_extension: Do not universalize beyond its models, benchmark, or conversational task.

body_usable_claim: Liu's introduction identifies controllability, inference latency, and fine-grained cultural distinction as limitations of LLMs in cross-cultural language learning.
evidence_location: Nature publisher HTML lines 86-90; article Introduction
forbidden_extension: These are background assertions, not findings from the paper's own LLM experiment.

body_usable_claim: Liu evaluates an AI-enhanced language-learning system with 262 learners over three months.
evidence_location: Nature publisher HTML lines 38-43; Methodology and Table 1
forbidden_extension: Do not describe the system as the present work's LLM architecture or use it as direct evidence for A3.

body_usable_claim: Graph RAG constructs a graph-based index and community summaries for global query-focused summarization.
evidence_location: arXiv:2404.16130, abstract and method description
forbidden_extension: Do not imply that the present system implements this pipeline.

body_usable_claim: A GraphRAG survey organizes the workflow into graph-based indexing, graph-guided retrieval, and graph-enhanced generation.
evidence_location: arXiv:2408.08921v2, abstract and workflow taxonomy
forbidden_extension: Do not use a survey taxonomy as evidence of the present system's effectiveness.

body_usable_claim: Educational content can be represented as knowledge graphs and integrated with LLMs for explanations, answers, and recommendations.
evidence_location: KaLLM 2024, abstract and pp.85-91
forbidden_extension: Do not claim educational KG+LLM integration is novel to this paper.

body_usable_claim: Standardize uses knowledge artifacts extracted from CEFR and Common Core standards to guide educational content generation.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2024, abstract and framework section
forbidden_extension: Do not claim structured standards guarantee factuality or eliminate hallucination.

body_usable_claim: The paper reports improved precise accuracy for standard-aligned generation in its evaluated settings.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2024, abstract and experiments
forbidden_extension: Do not transfer the reported percentage to HSK alignment or the present system.

body_usable_claim: Human and LLM judges are vulnerable to multiple judgment biases.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2024 PDF Section 2.2 pp.8302-8303; Section 3; Tables 1-3 pp.8304-8308
forbidden_extension: Do not claim human evaluation is bias-free or that one independent Judge is ground truth.

body_usable_claim: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation requires validation and robustness checks rather than uncritical use as an independent oracle.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2024 PDF Section 2.2 pp.8302-8303; Sections 4-5; conclusion
forbidden_extension: Do not attribute a bias subtype not evaluated by the cited experiment.

body_usable_claim: Programmable runtime rails can constrain topics, dialogue paths, and language style in LLM applications.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2023 System Demonstrations, abstract and toolkit architecture
forbidden_extension: Do not claim staged guardrails or runtime filtering are novel.

body_usable_claim: CodeGuard is a formally published CS-education guardrail framework with an 8,000-prompt taxonomy dataset and PromptShield classifier.
evidence_location: Findings of EACL 2026 PDF p.937, abstract lines 9-41; Sections 3-6
forbidden_extension: Do not equate prompt safety classification with output instructional-content quality.

body_usable_claim: CodeGuard reports 0.93 F1 and reduced harmful completions without degrading legitimate educational-task performance in its setting.
evidence_location: Findings of EACL 2026 PDF p.937 lines 32-40; experiment sections
forbidden_extension: Do not transfer its figures to this system or claim it measures cache pollution.

body_usable_claim: Education guardrail evaluation can jointly measure risk reduction and preservation of legitimate task performance.
evidence_location: Findings of EACL 2026 abstract and experiments, pp.937-949
forbidden_extension: Does not establish the present gate's false-positive or false-negative rates.

body_usable_claim: A non-education preprint compares SAS with five MAS variants under a shared global thinking-token budget across three model families.
evidence_location: arXiv:2604.02460v2 (preprint under review), PDF Section 4.3 pp.5-6 and Figure 1
forbidden_extension: Do not transfer its multi-hop reasoning result to educational generation; its budget excludes prompts and final answers.

body_usable_claim: The preprint reports SAS matching or outperforming MAS on its multi-hop tasks under its thinking-token control and identifies API budget-control artifacts.
evidence_location: arXiv:2604.02460v2, abstract; PDF Section 5.1 pp.6-7 and Table 1
forbidden_extension: Does not prove the present monolith will outperform or that input-plus-output token matching is equivalent.

body_usable_claim: CLCA separately evaluates dialogue-only intent-only and combined cultural-learning components.
evidence_location: ACL 2025 PDF Table 4 p.7
forbidden_extension: This is cultural-value alignment not native-culture-aware instructional generation.

body_usable_claim: CLCA also compares filtered and unfiltered cultural-interaction data.
evidence_location: ACL 2025 PDF Table 10 p.16
forbidden_extension: Do not infer that the present A3 or filtering gate has the same effect.

body_usable_claim: CLTE evaluates Chinese-as-a-second-language teaching competence including knowledge-point summaries and instructional-content design for simulated students.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2025 abstract; PDF Section 3 teaching-practice setup; Appendix A Figure 6 p.23968
forbidden_extension: Do not claim Chinese L2 automatic instructional-content generation is absent from prior work.

body_usable_claim: CLTE evaluates 13 multilingual and Chinese LLMs across knowledge examination and teaching-practice dimensions.
evidence_location: EMNLP 2025 abstract; PDF dataset/evaluation section
forbidden_extension: It does not compare MAS with a budget-matched monolith or test native-culture conditioning.

body_usable_claim: CodeHelp deploys an LLM assistant with multi-prompt guardrails intended to avoid directly revealing programming solutions.
evidence_location: Author manuscript Sections 1 and 3.2, pp.1-4; Figure 4 p.5; deployment Section 5 pp.7-8
forbidden_extension: Do not equate solution-withholding guardrails with output-quality cache admission.

body_usable_claim: An open-domain simulation studies LLM-generated content entering a retrieval-generation feedback loop and warns that erroneous generated content can be reinforced.
evidence_location: arXiv:2404.10496 abstract; PDF feedback-loop setup and discussion
forbidden_extension: This is not an education cache experiment and does not validate the present gate.

body_usable_claim: Controlled language-exercise generation has combined learner knowledge states with instructor constraints on domain and difficulty.
evidence_location: ACL 2023 abstract; pp.10184-10198 method section
forbidden_extension: The study is not Chinese-specific cross-cultural generation and does not validate BKT in the present system.
